sentences.text:
Date : 15-11-2023 Heard Mr. B. Choudhury, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. P. Borthakur,
learned Addl. P.P., Assam.
Page No.# 2/2 This is an application under Section 439 CrPC praying for bail by the petitioner,
namely, Rahul Al Amin in connection with Mangaldoi P.S. Case No. 427/2023 corresponding to GR No. 1523/2023 under Section 342/376 IPC R/w Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
It is alleged in the FIR that on the day of occurrence, the petitioner had entice away the 17 years victim girl and thereafter she was raped and also detained.
In her statement recorded under Section 164 CrPC, the victim girl has stated that she got introduced to the petitioner over mobile phone and they used to talk each other.
She stated that on one particular day, the petitioner along with some others came to her house and forcibly took her in a motorbike.
The victim girl also stated that she was forcibly married by the petitioner and now she is pregnant.
The victim girl was taken in the motorcycle, but she never tried to escape.
This court is of the opinion that the petitioner does not deserve to be detained for any further period of time.
Accordingly, the bail prayer is allowed.

Accordingly it is hereby directed that the petitioner abovenamed in connection with the aforesaid case, shall be released on bail of Rs. 25,000/- with one suitable surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Spl. Judge, Darrang, Mangaldoi.
The case diary shall be returned.
The bail application is disposed of.
